---
title: "Professional Meetings"
date: "2026-01-24"
draft: FALSE
categories: [opinion]
---

It's never a bad idea to come to a professional meeting with a succinct slide deck outlining: (1) what issues to discuss; (2) summaries of the issues; (3) your thoughts-on/attempts-at the issues; (4) your next steps; (5) and a blank slide for noting meeting discussions and next steps.
